description: Each case: a frame, the link it arrived on, what validate keeps and how many entries it drops. The sender is the sender seed (its Raven key and libp2p PeerId), the receiver the receiver seed. Kept DIRECT entries carry /p2p/<sender PeerId>; addresses are canonical text. A case whose frame carries custody entries (§12) also shows the kept custody_offer, custodian_tags_hex and custodian_tag_flags (the CUSTODIAN_TAG flags after validate, one per kept tag)
